package.description: Sample test application for ESRP Winget manifest publishing

en-US.description: Sample test application for ESRP Winget manifest publishing
en-US.longDescription:
This is a sample test application used to validate the ESRP Release service's
integration with Windows Package Manager (Winget). It helps test the end-to-end
flow of manifest creation, PR submission, and package publishing.
en-US.name: ESRP Winget Test Application
